description: Provision S3 IAM credentials for the XNS CLI. Creates an IAM user in the Relayer and writes ~/.xns/credentials so that `xns ls` and other S3 verbs work without further configuration. Call once after check_claim_status reaches STATE_3.

installation_id.description: Installation ID from check_claim_status STATE_3 result — used as cost_center_id in credentials

muse_token.description: Keycloak/Muse token — the same token used for get_host_tags and configure_vpd

relayer_ui_url.description: Relayer UI base URL (default: http://localhost:8888). Must be a loopback, private-network, or .local address — this tool sends your Muse token to it.

name: setup_cli_credentials
title: setup_cli_credentials
